boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain St. Joseph's University-New York
boards.description: Ten food-focused Brooklyn destinations with currently published late hours, selected as practical off-campus options for the Brooklyn campus area.

cards.title: Kellogg's Diner, Williamsburg
cards.subtitle: 518 Metropolitan Ave, Williamsburg
cards.notes: Use the diner’s published 24/7 schedule when you need a sit-down meal at an hour when a standard dinner service may be finished.
cards.short_summary: A Williamsburg diner with round-the-clock published hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Kellogg's Diner publishes that it is open 24 hours Monday through Sunday at 518 Metropolitan Avenue.

cards.title: Stay Fresh Grill & Deli, Bushwick
cards.subtitle: 887 Broadway, Bushwick
cards.notes: Plan a takeout or casual deli stop using the business’s all-day schedule; confirm your order method directly if you need delivery.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour deli with sandwiches, Mediterranean food, and smoothies.
cards.evidence_claim: Stay Fresh Grill & Deli states that its 887 Broadway location is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists every day as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Bijan's, Boerum Hill
cards.subtitle: 81 Hoyt St, Boerum Hill
cards.notes: For a later dinner in Downtown Brooklyn, use the published schedule and aim for the Friday or Saturday window that runs until 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Persian-American restaurant with midnight service most days.
cards.evidence_claim: Bijan's lists hours until 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday and until midnight Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–1 a.m.; Sun–Thu 11 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Mullane's, Fort Greene
cards.subtitle: 71 Lafayette Ave, Fort Greene
cards.notes: Treat this as a food stop near the Brooklyn Academy of Music area, checking the late-kitchen schedule before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Fort Greene restaurant with a separately stated late-night kitchen.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullane's publishes late-night kitchen hours until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 1 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists late-night kitchen: Sun–Wed until midnight; Thu–Sat until 1 a.m.

cards.title: Los Carnales, Park Slope
cards.subtitle: 53 5th Ave, Park Slope
cards.notes: Use the published carryout schedule for a late food run; weekday and weekend closing times differ, so check the day before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant publishing late-night hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Carnales lists hours until 2 a.m. Monday–Wednesday, 3 a.m. Thursday, and later on Friday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Mon–Wed until 2 a.m., Thu until 3 a.m., Fri until 4 a.m., Sat until noon, and Sun midnight–4 a.m.

cards.title: Tacos El Brother, Park Slope
cards.subtitle: 512 5th Ave, Park Slope
cards.notes: Build this into a late takeout plan when traveling through Park Slope, and use the posted 3:30 a.m. closing time as your cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A Brooklyn taco truck with a single published daily late-hours schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Tacos El Brother lists its Brooklyn location at 512 5th Avenue as open daily from 11:30 a.m. to 3:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists daily business hours of 11:30 a.m.–3:30 a.m.

cards.title: IHOP on Church Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2244 Church Ave, Flatbush
cards.notes: Use the official location page for a 24-hour breakfast-style option; Friday and Saturday overnight service is listed as pickup and delivery only.
cards.short_summary: A Church Avenue IHOP with round-the-clock hours and an overnight service caveat.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 2244 Church Avenue restaurant as open 24 hours daily, with pickup and delivery only Friday and Saturday from 10 p.m. to 7 a.m.
cards.source_title: IHOP Brooklyn Late Night Food — 2244 Church Ave
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 24-hour daily hours; Fri–Sat 10 p.m.–7 a.m. are pickup and delivery only.

cards.title: Sweet Science, East Williamsburg
cards.subtitle: 135 Graham Ave, East Williamsburg
cards.notes: For a meal before midnight, use the restaurant’s kitchen-close schedule rather than its broader dining-room hours, which vary by day.
cards.short_summary: A Brooklyn restaurant with kitchen service extending to 11:30 p.m. on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Sweet Science lists kitchen closing at 11:30 p.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, with indoor dining, takeout, and delivery hours also published.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists kitchen close at 11:30 p.m. Thursday–Saturday; other listed kitchen nights close at 10:30 p.m.

cards.title: African Pride, Crown Heights
cards.subtitle: 1895 Eastern Pkwy, Crown Heights
cards.notes: Use this as an Eastern Parkway dinner option when you need a later evening meal, relying on the business’s published 1 a.m. daily closing time.
cards.short_summary: A West African restaurant with the same late closing time listed throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: African Pride lists its Brooklyn location at 1895 Eastern Parkway as open until 1 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Sunday through Saturday hours ending at 1 a.m.

cards.title: El Dorado, Flatbush
cards.subtitle: 1228 Flatbush Ave, Flatbush
cards.notes: Schedule a Thursday-through-Saturday food run around the restaurant’s later posted close, while using the midnight schedule on the other days.
cards.short_summary: A Flatbush Mexican restaurant with 4 a.m. hours on three nights.
cards.evidence_claim: El Dorado lists hours until 4 a.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, and until midnight Sunday through Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Thu–Sat 11 a.m.–4 a.m.; Sun–Wed 11 a.m.–midnight.
